tomato__early_blight.registered_use: Early blight and fruit rot of tomato
tomato__early_blight.application_method: Foliar spray with thorough lower and upper leaf coverage upon disease onset
tomato__early_blight.source: CIB&RC Major Uses of Fungicides (Registered under Insecticides Act, 1968)
tomato__early_blight.section_reference: Approved Uses of Mancozeb 75 WP on Vegetables (Item 18)
tomato__early_blight.cautionary_notes: Wear protective gloves and mask during spray preparation. Avoid spraying during midday heat to prevent chemical scorch.

tomato__early_blight.registered_use: Early blight and anthracnose in tomato
tomato__early_blight.application_method: Foliar preventive spray; alternate with multi-site contact fungicides to prevent resistance
tomato__early_blight.cautionary_notes: Do not exceed 2 consecutive applications. Toxic to aquatic organisms; maintain 10m buffer from ponds.

tomato__late_blight.registered_use: Late blight in tomato and potato
tomato__late_blight.application_method: Foliar curative/protective spray at first appearance of greasy leaf spots
tomato__late_blight.section_reference: Approved Uses: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb on Solanaceous Crops
tomato__late_blight.cautionary_notes: Apply when morning dew has dried; ensure underside of leaves is reached.

tomato__late_blight.application_method: Foliar spray; penetrating translaminar activity halts mycelial growth
tomato__late_blight.cautionary_notes: Effective up to 48 hours after rain infection event.

tomato__bacterial_spot.formulation: 50% WP + Streptomycin Sulphate 90% w/w + Tetracycline Hydrochloride 10% w/w
tomato__bacterial_spot.registered_use: Bacterial leaf spot and bacterial canker of tomato
tomato__bacterial_spot.dose_per_liter: Copper Oxychloride 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline 0.1 g/L (100 ppm)
tomato__bacterial_spot.dose_per_hectare: 1.25 kg COC + 50 g Streptocycline in 500 L water
tomato__bacterial_spot.application_method: Foliar preventive spray on calm dry morning; repeat after 10-12 days if rains persist
tomato__bacterial_spot.section_reference: Bacterial Diseases of Solanaceous Crops, Section 4.3
tomato__bacterial_spot.cautionary_notes: Do not mix with acidic chemicals. Note: Strictly respect pre-harvest interval of 14 days.

tomato__septoria_leaf_spot.registered_use: Septoria leaf spot, early blight, and fruit rot of tomato
tomato__septoria_leaf_spot.application_method: Thorough foliar spray starting when lower leaves show first small dark pinhead lesions
tomato__septoria_leaf_spot.cautionary_notes: Eye irritant. Wear safety goggles and wash thoroughly after handling.

tomato__leaf_mold.registered_use: Leaf mold and powdery mildew of tomato
tomato__leaf_mold.application_method: Foliar spray ensuring undersides of canopy leaves are fully misted
tomato__leaf_mold.cautionary_notes: Ensure polyhouse ventilation is kept open during and 4 hours post-spraying.

tomato__yellow_leaf_curl.registered_use: Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) vector suppression in tomato
tomato__yellow_leaf_curl.application_method: Target underside of tender young terminal leaves where whiteflies feed and lay eggs
tomato__yellow_leaf_curl.source: CIB&RC Major Uses of Insecticides & TNAU CPG
tomato__yellow_leaf_curl.cautionary_notes: Pesticides target the vector, not the virus directly. Uproot virus-symptomatic plants before spraying.

potato__early_blight.registered_use: Early and late blight of potato
potato__early_blight.application_method: Foliar preventive spray at 45-50 days after planting
potato__early_blight.source: ICAR-CPRI Technical Bulletin: Potato Protection in Plains
potato__early_blight.cautionary_notes: Do not apply if rain is forecast within 4 hours. Ensure tractor sprayer pressure creates fine mist.

potato__late_blight.registered_use: Late blight in potato (curative and antisporulant)
potato__late_blight.dose_per_hectare: 1.0 kg Dimethomorph + 1.5 kg Mancozeb in 750 L water
potato__late_blight.application_method: Apply immediately upon appearance of late blight weather advisory
potato__late_blight.cautionary_notes: Anti-sporulant halts further lesion development even under moist conditions.

chilli__bacterial_spot.dose_per_hectare: 1.25 kg COC + 50 g Streptocycline in 500 L water
chilli__bacterial_spot.application_method: Foliar spray at 15-day intervals starting at initial symptom spot recognition
chilli__bacterial_spot.cautionary_notes: Do not apply during high wind (>15 km/h) to prevent drift.

rice__bacterial_blight.application_method: Foliar spray to coat upper canopy leaves and leaf tips
rice__bacterial_blight.cautionary_notes: Drain standing water from paddy fields before application. Avoid spraying during bloom/anthesis.

rice__brown_spot.registered_use: Brown spot and blast in rice
rice__brown_spot.application_method: Foliar spray at boot leaf stage and repeated during panicle emergence if needed
rice__brown_spot.cautionary_notes: Combine with corrective soil potassium application for lasting control.

rice__leaf_smut.registered_use: Smut, sheath blight, and foliar spots in rice
rice__leaf_smut.cautionary_notes: Strict pre-harvest interval of 30 days must be observed for export rice.

banana__black_sigatoka.dose_per_hectare: 500 ml Propiconazole + 5 L Mineral Oil in 500 L water
banana__black_sigatoka.application_method: Foliar mist directed at youngest 3-4 unfolded leaves with motorized knapsack or mistblower
banana__black_sigatoka.source: ICAR - National Research Centre for Banana (NRCB), Trichy
banana__black_sigatoka.section_reference: NRCB Technical Bulletin No. 34: Sigatoka Chemical Management
banana__black_sigatoka.cautionary_notes: Mineral oil acts as a physical penetrant and adherence agent. Do not spray during hot sun (>32°C).
